title: Basic English 850 配套绘本课程设计
status: 53 篇已完成制作并接入应用；850 词后续支线单独记录
intendedAudience: 中文母语、零基础至初级的成人与青少年

companionBooks.title: A book in a box
companionBooks.teachingDefinition: to move something so it is not closed
companionBooks.plot: 先打开盒子看到书，再打开书进行阅读。
companionBooks.continuity: 保留黄衣女孩、紫盒、绿书四张现有插画。

pages.text: My book is in the box.
pages.artwork: 闭合紫盒，人物坐在桌边。

pages.text: I open the box.
pages.artwork: 抬起盒盖，里面的绿书清楚可见。

pages.text: I open the book.
pages.artwork: 人物展开绿书，空盒留在旁边。

pages.text: Now I can read my book.
pages.artwork: 人物看展开的书；书页只有图画没有可读字。

check.prompt: I open a box. Is the box closed now?
check.explanation: The box is open after I open it.
check.chinese: 打开盒子之后，盒子现在关着吗？

output.sample: I open the book.
output.taskChinese: 换一种可以打开的日常物品。

companionBooks.sourceDefinition: to move something so it is not closed

books.title: My new friend
books.teachingDefinition: a person you like
books.senseChinese: 朋友，彼此愿意相处的人
books.plot: Li 认识 Anna，注意到她友好的举动，最后与她一起学习。朋友通过共同活动和互相关心建立联系。
books.continuity: Li 是讲述者，穿蓝上衣；Anna 穿米色上衣。四页同一学习室，避免仅靠两个人并排站立表达朋友。

pages.text: My name is Li.
pages.artwork: Li 在学习室门口作自我介绍，Anna 在桌旁微笑回应。无姓名牌。

pages.text: This is Anna. She is kind.
pages.artwork: Anna 为 Li 留出座位，把学习材料移到两人之间。

pages.text: Anna is my friend.
pages.artwork: 两人互相展示画作，目光交流；保持同一身份。

pages.text: I study English with my friend.
pages.artwork: 两人坐在桌边共同看图、练习表达。图片中的书页无文字。

check.prompt: Li and Anna study together. Anna is Li's friend. Who is Li's friend?
check.explanation: Anna is a person. Li and Anna study together.
check.chinese: Li 和 Anna 一起学习。Anna 是 Li 的朋友。谁是 Li 的朋友？

output.sample: This is my friend, Anna.
output.taskChinese: 介绍现实中的一位朋友；不要求使用真实姓名。

books.title: Where is my bag?
books.teachingDefinition: below something
books.senseChinese: 在某个物体下方
books.plot: 女孩寻找书包，先排除椅面，再在椅面下面发现书包，接着发现桌子下面的书。
books.continuity: 沿用已完成的红衣卷发女孩、青色书包、红书和木家具。椅面、桌面与下方物品必须同时可见。
books.sourceExample: The bag is under the chair.

pages.text: Where is my bag?
pages.artwork: 女孩在房间寻找；书包在椅面下的地板上，书在桌下。

pages.text: My bag is not on the chair.
pages.artwork: 女孩查看空椅面；不要把书包移动到椅子旁边。

pages.text: The bag is under the chair.
pages.artwork: 女孩蹲下指向椅腿之间、椅面下方的书包。

pages.text: My book is under the table.
pages.artwork: 女孩指向桌面下的书，桌面和书的上下关系完整可见。

check.prompt: The cup is under the table. Is the cup on the table?
options: Yes, it is on the table.
No, it is under the table.
check.explanation: Under means below. The cup is not on top of the table.
check.chinese: 杯子在桌子下面。它是在桌子上面吗？

output.sample: The bag is under the table.
output.taskChinese: 用家中另一样物品说一个位置句子。

books.title: A book for my friend
books.teachingDefinition: to let another person have something
books.senseChinese: 把某物交给另一个人，使对方持有
books.plot: 男孩有书，朋友没有；他把书交给朋友；最后朋友持有这本书。
books.continuity: 保留已确认的 give 四页插画和讲述者。单本绿色书；递交前后持有人明确。
books.sourceDefinition: to let another person have something
books.sourceExample: I give a book to my friend.

pages.text: I have a book. My friend is here.
pages.chinese: 我有一本书。我的朋友在这里。
pages.artwork: 蓝衣男孩持有绿书，米色衣女孩在旁边。

pages.text: My friend has no book.
pages.artwork: 女孩双手空着，男孩仍持有唯一一本书。

pages.text: I give a book to my friend.
pages.chinese: 我把一本书给我的朋友。
pages.artwork: 双手递交与接收同一本书，动作清楚。

pages.text: Now my friend has the book. She is happy.
pages.chinese: 现在我的朋友有了这本书。她很高兴。
pages.artwork: 女孩独自抱书，男孩双手空着。

check.prompt: I give a pen to my friend. Who has the pen now?
check.explanation: My friend has the pen after I give it to her.
check.chinese: 我把笔给朋友。现在谁有笔？

output.frame: I give a ___ to my friend.
output.sample: I give a cup to my friend.
output.taskChinese: 替换成笔、杯子等物品，表达给的对象。

contextSupport.chinese: 没有；例如 no book 是没有书

books.title: Food for a friend and me
books.teachingDefinition: as much as needed
books.senseChinese: 足以满足明确的需要
books.plot: 两位朋友各需要一份面包；一份不够，再增加一份后满足两人的需要。足够取决于需求，而非固定数量。
books.continuity: 同一张餐桌、两个餐位、相同大小的两片面包。需求在网页句子中交代，画面不写数字。

pages.text: My friend and I need some bread.
pages.chinese: 朋友和我需要一些面包。
pages.artwork: 两人在桌边准备吃饭，两个盘子空着。

pages.text: I have bread for me, but not for my friend.
pages.chinese: 我有自己吃的面包，却没有给朋友的。
pages.artwork: 一人盘里有一片面包，另一人盘子空着。

pages.text: Now I have bread for my friend.
pages.chinese: 现在我也有给朋友的面包了。
pages.artwork: 补上一片面包，两个餐位各有一片。

pages.text: My friend and I have enough bread for this meal.
pages.chinese: 这顿饭我们有足够的面包。
pages.artwork: 两人各拿到所需的一份；不暗示全世界两片面包就够。

check.prompt: I need a cup for me and a cup for my friend. I have one cup. Do I have enough?
check.explanation: My friend needs a cup, and I need a cup. My friend has no cup.
check.chinese: 我和朋友各需要一个杯子，但现在只有一个，够吗？

output.sample: I have enough food for this meal.
output.taskChinese: 说清楚什么足够、足够做什么，不能只背数量。

books.title: The way to the shop
books.teachingDefinition: the side opposite right
books.senseChinese: 以指定行走者的朝向为准的左侧
books.plot: 行走者来到路口，按左转指示进入商店所在的路，再到达商店。
books.continuity: 使用跟随行走者背后的稳定视角；四页不镜像翻转。路口左侧店铺以水果实物辨认，不用店名文字或箭头。

pages.text: I want to go to the shop.
pages.artwork: 背后视角看到行走者朝向前方路口。

pages.text: The shop is on my left.
pages.artwork: 维持相同朝向，店铺位于行走者左手一侧。

pages.text: I turn left.
pages.artwork: 人物实际转身进入左边的路，双脚朝向新方向。

pages.text: Now I am at the shop.
pages.artwork: 人物到达同一家摆有水果的商店。

check.prompt: The shop is on my left. Which way do I turn?
check.explanation: I turn to my left to go to the shop.
check.chinese: 商店在我的左边，我要向哪边转？

output.sample: The door is on my left.
output.taskChinese: 以自己当前朝向描述左边的一个真实物品。

books.title: Please say it again
books.teachingDefinition: to say or do again
books.senseChinese: 把同样的信息再说一次
books.plot: 人物问路，第一次没听清，礼貌请求重复，第二次听懂并走对路。
books.continuity: 同一位问路者和同一位回应者。关键路线句在网页中原样出现两次，不能把换一种说法称为 repeat。

pages.text: I ask for the way to the shop.
pages.artwork: 两人在具体路口交谈，不出现对话气泡。

pages.text: My friend says, "Turn left." I do not understand.
pages.chinese: 朋友说“向左转”。我没有听懂。
pages.artwork: 问路者露出不确定表情，朋友自然指向街道。

pages.text: "Please repeat," I say.
pages.artwork: 人物礼貌请求，保持同一沟通场景。

pages.text: My friend says, "Turn left." Now I understand.
pages.chinese: 朋友再次说“向左转”。现在我听懂了。
pages.artwork: 问路者点头，准备向左走；方向与前页相同。

check.prompt: I say, "Open the book." You ask me to repeat. What do I say?
check.explanation: To repeat is to say the same thing again.
check.chinese: 我说“打开书”，你请我重复，我应该再说哪一句？

output.sample: Please repeat the question.
output.taskChinese: 模拟没听清一句话时，礼貌请求对方重复。

books.title: A quiet time
books.teachingDefinition: quiet time after work
books.senseChinese: 停止工作或活动，让身体休息
books.plot: 主人公做完工作觉得累，停下来坐着休息，之后再决定是否继续。
books.continuity: 青年人物在家做日常整理后坐下。休息是停止活动的行为，不画成必然治愈疾病。

pages.text: I do my work.
pages.artwork: 人物整理桌面或搬放普通小物品。

pages.text: I am tired. I need rest.
pages.artwork: 人物停下工作，动作和表情显示疲倦。

pages.text: I have a quiet rest in a chair.
pages.artwork: 身体放松，双手没有继续做事；水杯放在旁边。

pages.text: After some rest, I feel ready to work again.
pages.chinese: 休息了一会儿，我觉得可以再次工作了。
pages.artwork: 人物平静起身；不暗示固定时长能让所有人恢复。

check.prompt: I am tired after work. Which action is rest?
options: A quiet time in a chair.
check.explanation: Rest is a quiet time when I stop working.
check.chinese: 工作后累了，哪一种行为是休息？

output.sample: After work, I need rest.
output.taskChinese: 说出自己在什么活动后需要休息。

books.title: At home together
books.teachingDefinition: a group with relations such as mother and son
books.senseChinese: 具有家庭成员关系的一组人，不以所有成员住在一起为必要条件
books.plot: 讲述者依次介绍自己的家人，再呈现一家人一起做饭、吃饭的日常。
books.continuity: 一个具体家庭是例子，不把母亲父亲孩子的构成当作 family 的唯一条件。四页人物身份保持一致。

pages.text: This is my mother.
pages.artwork: 讲述者与母亲在家里准备餐桌。

pages.text: This is my father. This is my sister.
pages.chinese: 这是我的父亲。这是我的姐妹。
pages.artwork: 父亲和姐妹走到桌边帮忙。

pages.text: This is my family.
pages.artwork: 已经介绍过的家人与讲述者一起准备饭菜。

pages.text: My family has a meal together.
pages.artwork: 同一组人物围桌用餐，温暖自然。

check.prompt: My mother is a person in my ___.
check.explanation: My mother is a person in my family.
check.chinese: 母亲是我的什么中的一员？

output.sample: This is my sister.
output.taskChinese: 介绍一位家人；允许使用虚构家庭，不强求披露个人经历。

books.title: Water from the sky
books.teachingDefinition: water falling from clouds
books.senseChinese: 从云中落下的雨水
books.plot: 人物在窗边看到云、落下的水和被雨水浇到的花园，辨认降雨。
books.continuity: 窗外同一座花园，雨水从上方向下落，不与水管浇花混淆；雨丝不画成箭头。

pages.text: There are clouds over the garden.
pages.artwork: 人物在室内窗边看向有云的花园。

pages.text: Now there is rain.
pages.artwork: 雨水从云下落到花园，窗玻璃出现水滴。

pages.text: The rain gives water to the flowers.
pages.artwork: 同一花园里的花和地面被雨水浇到。

pages.text: I look at the rain from my window.
pages.artwork: 人物安全留在室内，窗外持续下雨。

check.prompt: Water falls from clouds. Is this rain?
check.explanation: Rain is water falling from clouds.
check.chinese: 水从云中落下来，这是雨吗？

output.sample: There is rain in the garden.
output.taskChinese: 描述一处正在下雨的具体场景。

books.title: A page for my work
books.teachingDefinition: an account on paper
books.senseChinese: 把做过或看到的事情记在纸上
books.plot: 人物完成两项任务，在纸上记录，后来查看记录确认自己做了什么。
books.continuity: 纸面文字由网页的独立可访问文字区展示。插画里的纸保持无可读字，不使用含义不明的装饰勾号代替任务记录。

pages.text: Today I do some work.
pages.artwork: 人物完成摆好书和整理桌面两件具体工作。

pages.text: I write a record of my work.
pages.chinese: 我写下自己的工作记录。
pages.artwork: 人物拿笔在纸上记录；旁边网页文字呈现记录。

semanticText.label: Today
lines: I put the books on the table.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a record of my work today.

pages.text: The record shows what I do today.
pages.chinese: 记录显示我今天做了什么。
pages.artwork: 人物看纸，网页记录明确列出两项已完成的工作。

semanticText.label: Today
lines: I put the books on the table.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a record of my work today.

pages.text: I keep the record for another day.
pages.chinese: 我把记录留到以后的日子查看。
pages.artwork: 人物把同一张纸放进文件夹或盒中。

check.prompt: Which is a record of my work?
options: A page with what I do.
check.explanation: A record keeps an account of what I do.
check.chinese: 哪一种可以是我的工作记录？

output.sample: Today I open my book and study English.
output.taskChinese: 写下一项今天做过的事，作为可再次查看的文字记录。

books.title: Why is my friend happy?
books.teachingDefinition: for the reason that
books.senseChinese: 连接一件事和说明它的原因的句子
books.plot: 朋友没有书，男孩因此把书给她；朋友因有了书而高兴。两次把事件与原因直接说清楚。
books.continuity: 复用已经确认的赠书插画；同一画面用于不同重点时，网页句子与任务必须确实教 because。
books.sourceExample: I study English because it is useful.

pages.text: My friend has no book.
pages.artwork: 女孩空手，男孩持绿书；使用 give 第2页。

pages.text: I have a book for my friend.
pages.chinese: 我有一本书要给我的朋友。
pages.artwork: 男孩持书看向女孩；使用 give 第1页。

pages.text: I give my friend the book because she has no book.
pages.chinese: 我把书给朋友，因为她没有书。
pages.artwork: 递书动作；使用 give 第3页。

pages.text: My friend is happy because she has a book now.
pages.chinese: 我的朋友很高兴，因为她现在有书了。
pages.artwork: 女孩持书微笑；使用 give 第4页。

check.prompt: I open the door because my friend is here. Why do I open the door?
check.explanation: My friend is here. That is the reason I open the door.
check.chinese: 我开门，因为朋友来了。开门的原因是什么？

output.sample: I am happy because my friend is here.
output.taskChinese: 给出一个自己的原因；合理原因不只一个。

books.title: Tomorrow in the garden
books.teachingDefinition: a word for future action
books.senseChinese: 谈论将来的计划或行动
books.plot: 今天两位朋友在室内计划明天去花园，准备物品，再在下一天实行计划。
books.continuity: 网页用 Today 和 Tomorrow 标明时间；每页是一幅完整场景。计划画面只表现讨论和准备，不把想象云泡画进插画。

pages.text: Today I am at home.
pages.artwork: 人物在家中与朋友计划次日活动。

semanticText.label: Today
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The persons are at home today. They talk about tomorrow.

pages.text: Tomorrow I will go to the garden.
pages.artwork: 仍在今天的家中，人物准备外出物品；时间由网页说明。

semanticText.label: Today
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The persons are at home today. They talk about tomorrow.

pages.text: My friend will go with me.
pages.chinese: 我的朋友会和我一起去。
pages.artwork: 同一位朋友一起准备，保持还未出发。

semanticText.label: Today
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The persons are at home today. They talk about tomorrow.

pages.text: Now it is the next day. My friend and I go to the garden.
pages.chinese: 现在到了第二天。我们去花园。
pages.artwork: 场景转到次日花园，兑现前两页计划。

semanticText.label: The next day
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The next day is here. The persons go to the garden.

check.prompt: Today I am at home. Tomorrow I will go to the shop. When will I go to the shop?
check.explanation: Will is used for the future action.
check.chinese: 今天在家，明天将去商店。去商店是什么时候？

output.sample: Tomorrow I will study English.
output.taskChinese: 说一项明天的计划；计划表达不等于未来必定发生。

books.title: A small friend at home
books.teachingDefinition: a small animal often living at home
books.senseChinese: 猫，一种具体的动物
books.plot: 一只猫从门边走到椅子下，再到主人身边，最后安静睡觉。猫的外形和行动贯穿全篇。
books.continuity: 同一只橘白猫，真实猫形、四肢和尾巴；不拟人穿衣，不用猫头图标。
books.sourceDefinition: a small animal in a home
books.sourceExample: The cat is near the chair.

pages.text: There is a cat near the door.
pages.artwork: 完整橘白猫站在门边，耳朵、尾巴和身体可见。

pages.text: The cat is under the chair.
pages.artwork: 同一只猫进入椅面下方；保留清楚的上下关系。

pages.text: The cat is near my hand.
pages.artwork: 人物蹲下，猫主动靠近垂下的手。

pages.text: Now the cat is sleeping.
pages.artwork: 猫在柔软垫子上自然蜷卧，不画睡眠文字或符号。

check.prompt: Which animal is in the story?
check.explanation: The small animal in the story is a cat.
check.chinese: 故事里的动物是什么？

output.sample: The cat is near the door.
output.taskChinese: 描述猫的一个位置或正在发生的动作。

books.title: A clean table
books.teachingDefinition: soft material used for cleaning
books.senseChinese: 用来擦拭的布，区别于衣服 clothes
books.plot: 桌面洒了水，人物拿布吸水擦拭，把桌面清理好。
books.continuity: 一块可辨认的蓝色织物，保留褶皱、厚度和手持方式。不能用纸巾或衣服替代。

pages.text: There is water on the table.
pages.artwork: 杯边少量水洒在桌面，人物注意到。

pages.text: I have a soft cloth.
pages.artwork: 手中展示同一块蓝布，布边和织物纹理可见。

pages.text: I use the cloth to clean the table.
pages.artwork: 布贴着桌面擦过水迹，动作清楚。

pages.text: The table is clean. I wash the cloth.
pages.chinese: 桌子干净了。我把布洗一洗。
pages.artwork: 干净桌面留在背景，人物在水盆中清洗这块布。

check.prompt: Which thing can I use to clean this table?
check.explanation: The cloth can take up the water as I clean.
check.chinese: 这里可以用哪件东西擦桌子？

output.frame: I use a cloth to clean ___.
output.sample: I use a cloth to clean the table.
output.taskChinese: 说清楚布在这个场景中的用途。

books.title: A place for the cup
books.teachingDefinition: the part between the sides
books.senseChinese: 一个范围两侧之间的中间部分
books.plot: 人物要把杯子放在桌面中间，先看两侧，再把杯子移到远离两边的中心位置。
books.continuity: 同一长方形桌面，镜头略俯视，左右边缘完整。不要只因杯子处于图片中心就声称它在桌子中间。
books.sourceExample: The cup is in the middle.

pages.text: Here is a cup on the table.
pages.artwork: 杯子靠近桌面左边缘，桌子完整可见。

pages.text: The cup is near the left side.
pages.artwork: 同一俯视角，明确杯子与桌左边缘的接近。

pages.text: I put the cup in the middle of the table.
pages.chinese: 我把杯子放到桌子中间。
pages.artwork: 手移动杯子到桌面两侧之间的中间区域。

pages.text: Now the cup is in the middle.
pages.artwork: 杯子静止在桌面中部，两个边缘都保留在画面里。

check.prompt: The cup is in the middle of the table. Is it near the left edge?
check.explanation: In this scene the cup is between the sides, not near the edge.
check.chinese: 杯子在这张桌面的中间，它靠近左边缘吗？

output.frame: The ___ is in the middle of ___.
output.sample: The book is in the middle of the table.
output.taskChinese: 必须说出“什么的中间”，使参照范围明确。

books.title: The same number
books.teachingDefinition: the same in number
books.senseChinese: 数量相等，本篇只教数量这一义
books.plot: 两张桌子需要同样多的杯子；先一边两个、一边一个，再补一个，最终数量相等。
books.continuity: 同款同大小杯子，桌面干净、各组分开；数量变化由实际杯子呈现，不写等号或数字。
books.sourceDefinition: the same in number or size

pages.text: This table has 2 cups.
pages.artwork: 左桌上两个完全相同的杯子。

semanticText.label: Cups on the tables
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The left table has 2 cups. The right table has one cup. The numbers are not equal.

pages.text: That table has one cup. The numbers are not equal.
pages.chinese: 那张桌子有一个杯子。数量不相等。
pages.artwork: 两桌同时可见：左二右一。

semanticText.label: Cups on the tables
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The left table has 2 cups. The right table has one cup. The numbers are not equal.

pages.text: I put another cup on that table.
pages.chinese: 我在那张桌子上再放一个杯子。
pages.artwork: 人物往右桌补上相同杯子，原有杯子不移动。

semanticText.label: Cups on the tables
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The left table has 2 cups. The right table has 2 cups. The numbers are equal.

pages.text: Now the numbers of cups are equal.
pages.chinese: 现在杯子的数量相等了。
pages.artwork: 两桌各有两个杯子；网页文字复述数量，不能仅靠颜色判断。

semanticText.label: Cups on the tables
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The left table has 2 cups. The right table has 2 cups. The numbers are equal.

check.prompt: 2 books here and 2 books there. Are the numbers equal?
check.explanation: The groups have the same number of books. The numbers are equal.
check.chinese: 这里两本书，那里也两本，数量相等吗？

output.sample: The numbers of cups are equal.
output.taskChinese: 比较两组可数物品；不把大小和数量混为一谈。

books.title: Under the tree
books.teachingDefinition: a place where a tree or other thing keeps the light of the sun off it
books.senseChinese: 被树等遮住直射阳光的阴凉处
books.plot: 人物走过阳光照射的花园，来到树下的阴凉区域休息。
books.continuity: 阳光方向稳定，树冠与地面的投影对应；shade 不是单独黑色块或夜晚。
books.sourceDefinition: a dark place under a tree

pages.text: The sun is bright in the garden.
pages.artwork: 人物走在明亮的花园小路，旁边有一棵大树。

pages.text: The tree makes shade on the earth.
pages.chinese: 树在地面上遮出一片阴凉。
pages.artwork: 清楚呈现树冠遮住阳光、树下较暗的连续区域。

pages.text: I go to the shade under the tree.
pages.artwork: 人物从阳光区域走入树冠下的阴影区域。

pages.text: I rest in the shade.
pages.artwork: 人物在树下休息，背景仍是白天明亮花园。

check.prompt: Where is the shade in this story?
options: Under the tree, out of the sun.
check.explanation: The tree keeps the light of the sun off the place below it.
check.chinese: 故事中的阴凉处在哪里？

output.sample: There is shade under the tree.
output.taskChinese: 找到一个被物体遮住直射阳光的地方。

books.title: A key in my coat
books.teachingDefinition: a small part of clothes for keeping things
books.senseChinese: 衣服上可以装小东西的口袋
books.plot: 人物出门前把钥匙装进外套口袋，到门前再从同一口袋取出。
books.continuity: 口袋缝在外套上；整段过程中钥匙、外套颜色一致，不能误用手提包。
books.sourceExample: The key is in the pocket.

pages.text: I have a key in my hand.
pages.artwork: 人物站在门边，手里清楚拿着钥匙。

pages.text: My coat has a pocket.
pages.artwork: 近一些展示外套上的实际口袋开口。

pages.text: I put the key in my pocket.
pages.artwork: 手把钥匙送进口袋，钥匙部分进入开口。

pages.text: At the door, I take the key out of my pocket.
pages.chinese: 到了门边，我从口袋里取出钥匙。
pages.artwork: 同一只手从同一口袋取出同一把钥匙。

check.prompt: A small part of my coat keeps my key. What is it?
check.explanation: The pocket is part of the coat and can keep a small thing.
check.chinese: 外套上装钥匙的小部分叫什么？

output.sample: I keep my key in my pocket.
output.taskChinese: 说一种适合放入口袋的小物品。

books.title: A warm meal
books.teachingDefinition: warm liquid food
books.senseChinese: 以液体为主、可以作为食物的汤
books.plot: 人物准备一锅汤，把汤盛到容器里，再用勺子食用。
books.continuity: 成人操作锅；人物的手远离热源。用可见液体和食材表现汤，不把纯水、固体饭或烟雾当汤。

pages.text: There is soup in the pot.
pages.artwork: 一锅可见液体和少量蔬菜的汤，锅在安全台面上。

pages.text: The soup is warm.
pages.artwork: 成人把汤盛进适合用勺子吃的容器，只有轻微热气。

pages.text: I have a spoon for my soup.
pages.artwork: 人物拿勺子，容器里的汤仍清楚可见。

pages.text: The soup is part of my meal.
pages.chinese: 汤是我这一餐的一部分。
pages.artwork: 人物平静用餐，桌上保留一份主食与这份汤。

check.prompt: Which food can I eat with a spoon in this story?
check.explanation: Soup is liquid food. I can take some soup with a spoon.
check.chinese: 这个故事里用勺子吃的食物是什么？

output.sample: The soup is warm.
output.taskChinese: 用一个已学形容词描述汤，不推断营养或医疗功效。

books.title: A place for my pens
books.teachingDefinition: a part of a table like a box that moves in and out
books.senseChinese: 家具中可以拉出、推进的抽屉
books.plot: 人物打开桌子的抽屉，放入散放的笔，再关上；下次从同一抽屉找到笔。
books.continuity: 抽屉始终连在同一张桌子上，滑动方向一致；不能画成桌上的独立盒子。

pages.text: My pens are on the table.
pages.artwork: 桌面有两支笔，桌子带一个可辨认的抽屉。

pages.text: I open the drawer in the table.
pages.artwork: 抽屉从桌子里滑出，内部空间清楚可见。

pages.text: I put the pens in the drawer.
pages.artwork: 人物把原来的两支笔放进抽屉内部。

pages.text: Now my pens have a place in the drawer.
pages.chinese: 现在我的笔有了放在抽屉里的固定位置。
pages.artwork: 人物再次打开同一抽屉取笔，桌面整洁。

check.prompt: Which part of the table moves out and keeps my pens?
check.explanation: A drawer is part of the table and moves in and out.
check.chinese: 桌子上可以滑出、存放笔的是哪个部分？

output.sample: I keep my pens in the drawer.
output.taskChinese: 说明自己的一个抽屉存放什么。

books.title: At the same time
books.teachingDefinition: at the same time as
books.senseChinese: 两个动作在时间上同时发生，本篇不教对比义
books.plot: 两人共用学习时间：一人读书时另一人写字，然后交换活动，再一起整理。
books.continuity: 每页同一完整场景中同时展示两人动作；同时性由句子和场景共同表达，不用拼贴或时间轴烘焙进图。

pages.text: My friend and I are at the table.
pages.artwork: 两人分别准备书和纸笔。

pages.text: I read while my friend writes.
pages.chinese: 我读书的时候，朋友在写字。
pages.artwork: 同一画面同时看见讲述者看书、朋友执笔写字。

pages.text: My friend reads while I write.
pages.chinese: 朋友读书的时候，我在写字。
pages.artwork: 两人交换活动，仍在同一时间同一场景。

pages.text: After the work, I put my book and pen in my bag.
pages.chinese: 做完后，我把书和笔放进袋子里。
pages.artwork: 讲述者停止读写，把自己的书和笔放进袋中；朋友也已停止读写。

check.prompt: I read while my friend writes. Do my friend and I do this at the same time?
options: No, I read after my friend stops.
check.explanation: While tells of 2 actions at the same time.
check.chinese: 我读书时朋友写字，这两个动作是在同一时间吗？

output.sample: I read while my friend writes.
output.taskChinese: 描述两个能同时发生的活动。

books.narratorChinese: 最初读书、随后写字的人

books.title: Show me one
books.teachingDefinition: one thing that shows what a kind of thing is like
books.senseChinese: 用来说明一类事物的一个具体例子
books.plot: 人物想知道 fruit 指什么，朋友先拿苹果举例，再换橙子，理解例子不是整个类别。
books.continuity: 同一水果摊和人物，苹果、橙子都具体可见。分类词和解释在网页文字中展示。

pages.text: My friend asks for an example of fruit.
pages.chinese: 朋友想看一个水果的例子。
pages.artwork: 两人在水果摊边，朋友自然询问。

pages.text: I show an apple. An apple is an example of fruit.
pages.chinese: 我拿出苹果。苹果是水果的一个例子。
pages.artwork: 人物展示一只苹果，其他水果作为少量背景。

pages.text: An orange is another example.
pages.artwork: 换成展示橙子，苹果仍留在同一摊位。

pages.text: There are different examples of fruit.
pages.artwork: 苹果、橙子并列可见，强调同类中的多个实例。

check.prompt: Which is an example of clothes?
check.explanation: A coat is one kind of clothes.
check.chinese: 哪一种是衣服的一个例子？

output.sample: An apple is an example of fruit.
output.taskChinese: 换一组已知的类别与实例，避免只会重复水果。

books.title: A cup for tea
books.teachingDefinition: a thing you choose from a group
books.senseChinese: 从多个选项中选出的东西，本篇教选择结果
books.plot: 人物需要茶杯，在大小两个杯子之间作选择，最后选定适合自己的小杯子。
books.continuity: 两个杯子除大小外尽量相同，选择动作由拿起其中一个体现。无需把 selection 画成勾选图标。

pages.text: I want a cup for my tea.
pages.chinese: 我想要一个喝茶的杯子。
pages.artwork: 人物在家中桌旁，看着两个杯子。

pages.text: Here is a small cup and a big cup.
pages.chinese: 这里有一个小杯子和一个大杯子。
pages.artwork: 同款杯子并列，只有大小差异。

pages.text: I choose the small cup. It is my selection.
pages.chinese: 我选小杯子。它是我选中的那个。
pages.artwork: 手明确拿起小杯子，大杯子留在原位。

pages.text: I use my selection for my tea.
pages.artwork: 人物用小杯子，大杯子放在旁边，不改变选择。

check.prompt: I choose the blue cup, not the red cup. What is my selection?
check.explanation: My selection is the cup I choose.
check.chinese: 我选蓝杯子而不是红杯子，我选中的是哪一个？

output.sample: My selection is the small cup.
output.taskChinese: 从两件实际物品中选择一件，再说出选择结果。

books.title: Why does the paper move?
books.teachingDefinition: something that makes an event take place
books.senseChinese: 使某件事发生的原因，本篇教名词
books.plot: 开窗时风把轻纸吹动；人物检查风和纸的关系，关窗后纸不再被这阵风吹动。
books.continuity: 同一张纸、同一扇窗；纸的移动和窗帘的摆动表现风。页面只描述这次事件，不把先后发生直接当作因果证明。

pages.text: The window is open. Wind comes in.
pages.artwork: 窗帘自然摆动，桌上只有一张轻纸。

pages.text: The wind moves the paper.
pages.artwork: 纸被同一阵风吹离原位，人物正在观察。

pages.text: The wind is the cause of this change.
pages.artwork: 仍呈现窗、风吹动的窗帘与移动的纸，说明具体原因。

pages.text: I close the window. The paper is on the table.
pages.artwork: 人物关窗，窗帘平静，纸稳定放在桌面。

check.prompt: Rain gives water to a plant. What is the cause of the water on the plant?
check.explanation: Rain brings water to the plant in this scene.
check.chinese: 雨水落到植物上，植物上出现这些水的原因是什么？

output.sample: The wind is the cause of the motion.
output.taskChinese: 说出一个有明确联系的原因和结果，允许用 because 辅助解释。

books.title: Why take a bag?
books.teachingDefinition: the reason for doing something
books.senseChinese: 做一件事想达到的目的
books.plot: 人物出门前拿空袋子，到商店装入食物，带回家，说明带袋子的用途与目的。
books.continuity: 同一只空袋逐步装入食物；目的文字放网页上，不用灯泡或靶心图标代表目的。

pages.text: I take an empty bag to the shop.
pages.chinese: 我带着一个空袋子去商店。
pages.artwork: 人物离家时手中袋子空着。

pages.text: I have a purpose for the bag.
pages.chinese: 我带这个袋子有一个目的。
pages.artwork: 人物来到食品摊，打开同一个袋子。

pages.text: My purpose is to carry the food home.
pages.chinese: 我的目的是把食物带回家。
pages.artwork: 人物把买好的食物装进袋子。

pages.text: The bag helps me carry the food.
pages.artwork: 人物提着装有食物的袋子回到家。

check.prompt: I take a cup because I want to drink water. What is my purpose?
check.explanation: The purpose is what I want to do with the cup.
check.chinese: 我为了喝水而拿杯子，我的目的是什么？

output.sample: My purpose is to carry the food home.
output.taskChinese: 解释一个日常动作想达到的目标。

books.title: Where is my key now?
books.teachingDefinition: not having something that was your property
books.senseChinese: 原先拥有的东西不在了造成的失去
books.plot: 人物原先有钥匙，之后发现口袋里没有，寻找仍未找到；把 loss 与暂时没看见区分开。
books.continuity: 开篇明确有同一把钥匙；后续多个具体位置均被查看。结尾不是凭空认定失窃，不虚构犯罪原因。开篇沿用 pocket 第 1 页的持钥匙画面，后续保持同一位穿赭色外套的人物；本篇用拥有、寻找及未找到的连续情节教授 loss。

pages.text: In the morning, I have my key.
pages.artwork: 人物把一把钥匙拿在手里，物品清楚可见。

pages.text: Now the key is not in my pocket.
pages.artwork: 人物查看空口袋，表情疑惑。

pages.text: I look for it. The key is not here.
pages.artwork: 人物查看桌面和袋子；一页保持一个房间场景。

pages.text: The loss of my key is a problem.
pages.chinese: 钥匙丢失给我带来了问题。
pages.artwork: 人物与朋友在门旁商量办法；钥匙仍没有找到。

check.prompt: I have a pen in the morning. Now I can find no pen. What is the loss?
options: A new cup on the table.
check.explanation: The pen was my property. Now I do not have it.
check.chinese: 原先有笔，寻找后仍找不到，丢失的是什么？

output.frame: The loss of ___ is a problem.
output.sample: The loss of my key is a problem.
output.taskChinese: 描述一个虚构的小物品丢失，不强迫分享私人损失。

books.title: In the library
books.teachingDefinition: a statement about what persons may or may not do
books.senseChinese: 共同场景中约定应当遵守的要求
books.plot: 人物来到供阅读的空间，理解轻声交流的规则，和朋友一起遵守，让大家继续阅读。
books.continuity: 同一图书馆。规则写在网页，不画可读告示；轻声行为以人物贴近自然交流表现，不用禁音图标。

pages.text: Persons are reading in the library.
pages.chinese: 人们正在图书馆里阅读。
pages.artwork: 几位人物各自阅读，环境安静。

pages.text: There is a rule: keep your voice low.
pages.chinese: 这里有一条规则：轻声说话。
pages.artwork: 朋友准备交谈，管理员自然提醒。

pages.text: My friend and I keep the rule.
pages.artwork: 两人靠近轻声交流，不打扰旁边读者。

pages.text: The rule helps persons read quietly.
pages.chinese: 这条规则帮助大家安静阅读。
pages.artwork: 同一批人物继续阅读，叙事结果与规则对应。

check.prompt: The rule is to keep your voice low. Which action keeps this rule?
options: A loud voice across the room.
check.explanation: Quiet talk keeps the rule in this library.
check.chinese: 规则要求轻声说话，哪种行为遵守规则？

output.sample: One rule here is to keep your voice low.
output.taskChinese: 为一个明确场景说明一条合理规则，不把个人偏好当所有地方的规则。

contextSupport.chinese: 人的说话声；keep your voice low 是轻声说话

books.title: From home to the market
books.teachingDefinition: the act of going from one place to another
books.senseChinese: 从一处到另一处的一段行程
books.plot: 人物从家出发，乘公交沿路前往集市，到达后回顾整段旅程。
books.continuity: 重复同一外套和袋子；家门、公交车、集市在不同完整场景出现。不要把四处地点拼成地图插画。

pages.text: My journey starts at home.
pages.artwork: 人物带空袋走出家门。

pages.text: I take a bus to the market.
pages.artwork: 人物坐在公交座位上，窗外是道路。

pages.text: The bus goes on the road.
pages.artwork: 自然街景中的公交车，人物衣着在车窗中可辨。

pages.text: My journey ends at the market.
pages.artwork: 人物下车来到同一集市入口。

check.prompt: A journey starts at home and ends at school. Where does it end?
check.explanation: The end of this journey is school.
check.chinese: 从家去学校的行程终点在哪里？

output.frame: My journey starts at ___ and ends at ___.
output.sample: My journey starts at home and ends at the market.
output.taskChinese: 说清楚一段行程的起点和终点。

books.title: Persons working together
books.teachingDefinition: persons or things together
books.senseChinese: 被放在一起考虑的一组人，本篇只教人群义
books.plot: 三个人一起整理花园，分别做不同工作，最后共同完成，识别 group 与成员的关系。
books.continuity: 固定三个人及服装；不把路上偶然出现的所有人都算作同一工作小组。

pages.text: 3 persons come to work in the garden.
pages.artwork: 三位人物带日常园艺用品会合。

pages.text: They are a group.
pages.artwork: 三人一起商量工作，空间与互动形成明确一组。

pages.text: One person brings water. The others clean.
pages.chinese: 一个人送水，其他人清理。
pages.artwork: 同一画面中三人各有工作，成员不增减。

pages.text: The group finishes the work together.
pages.chinese: 这个小组一起完成了工作。
pages.artwork: 同样三人在整理好的花园边休息。

check.prompt: 3 friends work together. Are they a group?
check.explanation: The 3 friends work together in a group.
check.chinese: 三个朋友一起组成小队做事，他们是一个小组吗？

output.sample: My group has 3 persons.
output.taskChinese: 介绍一组人的成员数和共同活动。

books.narratorChinese: 描述三人小组的旁观者

books.title: After the garden work
books.teachingDefinition: not clean
books.senseChinese: 表面有泥土或污物的，不干净
books.plot: 人物接触花园泥土后双手沾土，洗手后变干净，隔离 dirty 与正常肤色的区别。
books.continuity: 手的肤色全程一致，污物用明显附着的泥土表现。不能用深色皮肤代表脏。

pages.text: I work in the garden.
pages.artwork: 人物接触土和植物，背景为普通家庭花园。

pages.text: Now my hands are dirty.
pages.artwork: 近景显示同一双手沾着可辨认的泥土。

pages.text: I wash my dirty hands with water and soap.
pages.chinese: 我用水和肥皂洗脏了的手。
pages.artwork: 在水槽边洗手，肥皂和流水可见。

pages.text: Now my hands are clean.
pages.artwork: 相同肤色的手已无泥土，与前页保持光照一致。

check.prompt: There is earth on my shoes after garden work. Are they dirty?
options: No, the earth makes the shoes clean.
check.explanation: The earth on the shoes makes the shoes dirty in this scene.
check.chinese: 园艺后鞋上有泥，鞋子脏了吗？

output.frame: My ___ is dirty. I will clean it.
output.sample: My coat is dirty. I will clean it.
output.taskChinese: 说一个具体物品的状态及合理处理。

books.title: A cloth in the sun
books.teachingDefinition: with no water on or in it
books.senseChinese: 没有水分或已不潮湿的，本篇教状态
books.plot: 洗过的布含水、滴水；人物把布挂在通风处，过一段时间后观察到布干了。
books.continuity: 同一块蓝布，初页明显滴水，后页无水滴、自然轻软。时间变化放网页；不能声称所有布固定多久干。

pages.text: I wash the cloth. There is water in it.
pages.artwork: 人物在水盆上拿起蓝布，水滴落入盆中。

pages.text: I put the cloth in the sun.
pages.artwork: 同一块布晾在安全的架子上，仍有少量水滴。

pages.text: After some time, the cloth is dry.
pages.artwork: 同一布已无水滴，人物触摸检查，环境连续。

pages.text: I use the dry cloth again.
pages.artwork: 人物把布折好用于擦一个干净杯子外侧。

check.prompt: A cloth has no water in it now. Is it dry?
check.explanation: Dry means it does not have water on or in it.
check.chinese: 一块布现在没有水分了，它是干的吗？

output.sample: The cloth is dry now.
output.taskChinese: 描述具体物品的干燥状态，不把 dry 等同于 clean。

books.title: A picture for the wall
books.teachingDefinition: pictures and other things that express ideas or feelings
books.senseChinese: 通过图画等作品表达想法或感受
books.plot: 人物观察花园，选择颜色画出自己的感受，把完成的画挂在墙上，与朋友交流。
books.continuity: 人物画作由简单具体花园图像构成，不要求照片般准确，也不把艺术等同于昂贵或写实。

pages.text: I look at the flowers in the garden.
pages.artwork: 人物观察几株花，手中带画具。

pages.text: I make a picture with colors.
pages.artwork: 人物在纸上画花园，无文字。

pages.text: My art shows how I feel about the garden.
pages.chinese: 我的艺术作品表达我对花园的感受。
pages.artwork: 展示色彩鲜明的花园画作，人物指向自己喜欢的部分。

pages.text: I put my art on the wall for my friend to see.
pages.chinese: 我把作品放到墙上给朋友看。
pages.artwork: 同一幅画在墙上，朋友自然欣赏。

check.prompt: I make a picture to show an idea. Can it be art?
options: No, art is only for experts.
check.explanation: A picture can express an idea. It can be art.
check.chinese: 我画一幅画表达想法，它可以是艺术作品吗？

output.sample: My art shows my garden.
output.taskChinese: 画一幅小画，并用一句英语说它表达什么。

books.title: Near or far from home?
books.teachingDefinition: the space between 2 places
books.senseChinese: 两个地点之间的距离
books.plot: 同一个家到商店近、到学校远，人物分别走两条路，理解 distance 是地点间的间隔。
books.continuity: 固定同一家的起点；每页是完整街景。距离记录与比较在网页文字中，避免把画面透视大小直接当距离。

pages.text: The shop is near my home.
pages.artwork: 同一条街景同时可见家门和近处商店。

pages.text: The distance from home to the shop is short.
pages.artwork: 人物沿短路段步行，起点和终点仍能辨认。

pages.text: The school is far from my home.
pages.artwork: 另一次从同一家出发前往远处学校，网页说明同一起点。

pages.text: The distance to the school is great.
pages.artwork: 人物到达学校；网页对比“家到商店”和“家到学校”。

semanticText.label: The same home
lines: Home to the shop: a short distance.
Home to the school: a great distance.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The journeys start at the same home. The shop is near and the school is far.

check.prompt: The shop is near home. The school is far from home. Which journey covers more distance?
check.explanation: The journeys start at the same home. The shop is near, and the school is far.
check.chinese: 同样从家出发，到商店近、到学校远，哪个距离更长？

output.sample: The distance from home to the shop is short.
output.taskChinese: 明确两个端点，再描述距离，不只说 near 或 far。

books.title: The tree gets big
books.teachingDefinition: an increase in size
books.senseChinese: 生物随时间长大，本篇教植物生长
books.plot: 人物照看一棵小树，用同一场景在不同时间看到它长高、树冠变大。
books.continuity: 同一树的位置、花园围栏和镜头高度保持稳定；时间标签在网页，四页不做拼贴。

pages.text: There is a small tree in the garden.
pages.artwork: 固定围栏旁的小树，人物在旁边浇水。

semanticText.label: At first
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The tree is small at first.

pages.text: The tree has water and light.
pages.artwork: 同一小树在正常阳光中，不暗示浇一次水就立即长大。

semanticText.label: At first
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The tree is small at first.

pages.text: After a year, the tree is big.
pages.chinese: 过了一年，这棵树长大了。
pages.artwork: 网页标明一年后，固定参照下树明显长大。

semanticText.label: After a year
semanticText.accessibleSummary: After a year, the same tree is big.

pages.text: This change is the growth of the tree.
pages.chinese: 这种变化就是树的生长。
pages.artwork: 展示长大的同一棵树与持续照看的人物。

semanticText.label: After a year
semanticText.accessibleSummary: After a year, the same tree is big.

check.prompt: A small plant gets big over time. What is this?
check.explanation: Growth is an increase in size over time.
check.chinese: 植物随时间长大了，这是什么变化？

output.frame: I can see the growth of ___.
output.sample: I can see the growth of the tree.
output.taskChinese: 说一种随时间长大的植物，不把搬近镜头当生长。

books.title: Help with a bag
books.teachingDefinition: to help a person or thing
books.senseChinese: 通过实际帮助支持某人，本篇教帮助义
books.plot: 朋友带着重袋子难以继续走，讲述者承担一部分重量，两人一起完成搬运。
books.continuity: 青年或成人提普通生活物品，重量适度；帮助方式具体可见，避免无行动的点赞图标。
books.sourceDefinition: to help a person or thing

pages.text: My friend has a bag full of food.
pages.chinese: 朋友提着一个装满食物的袋子。
pages.artwork: 朋友停下调整手势，袋子里是普通杂货。

pages.text: The bag is not light. She needs help.
pages.artwork: 朋友开口求助，讲述者走近。

pages.text: I support my friend by carrying some of the food.
pages.chinese: 我帮忙提一部分食物，支持朋友。
pages.artwork: 讲述者拿走部分物品装入另一只袋子，两人实际分担。

pages.text: I carry food, and she carries food. I support her with this work.
pages.chinese: 我提食物，她也提食物。我在这件事上支持她。
pages.artwork: 两人各提适度重量的袋子到家。

check.prompt: My friend needs help with her work. Which action can support her?
options: Helping her with part of the work.
check.explanation: To support her here is to give useful help.
check.chinese: 朋友需要帮忙做事，哪种行为是在支持她？

output.sample: I support my friend by helping with the work.
output.taskChinese: 提出一种具体、可实行的帮助方式。

books.title: Different cups for different persons
books.teachingDefinition: what a person has in mind about something
books.senseChinese: 一个人对事物的看法，可以与别人不同
books.plot: 两人看同样的杯子，一人喜欢小杯，另一人喜欢大杯，各自说明看法，不把偏好判成唯一正确答案。
books.continuity: 同一对杯子，人物身份明确。偏好和观点用网页句子表达，插画不负责证明谁更正确。
books.sourceDefinition: what a person has in mind

pages.text: My friend and I look at 2 cups.
pages.chinese: 朋友和我看着两个杯子。
pages.artwork: 同款大小两个杯子放在两人中间。

pages.text: In my opinion, the small cup is best for me.
pages.chinese: 在我看来，小杯子最适合我。
pages.artwork: 讲述者拿起小杯子，朋友仍看着另一只。

pages.text: My friend likes the big cup. That is her opinion.
pages.chinese: 朋友喜欢大杯子。这是她的看法。
pages.artwork: 朋友选择大杯子，不表现争吵或对错符号。

pages.text: My opinion is different from hers. I like my cup, and she likes her cup.
pages.chinese: 我的看法和她不同。我喜欢我的杯子，她喜欢她的杯子。
pages.artwork: 两人各使用自己偏好的杯子。

check.prompt: I say, "I like the small cup best." Is this my opinion?
options: No, all persons have to like it best.
check.explanation: The sentence tells what I like. It is my opinion.
check.chinese: 我说“我最喜欢小杯子”，这是我的看法吗？

output.frame: In my opinion, ___ is good for me because ___.
output.sample: In my opinion, the small cup is good for me because it is light.
output.taskChinese: 给出一个看法和理由，允许不同答案。

books.title: A walk by moving water
books.teachingDefinition: a long, natural body of moving water on land
books.senseChinese: 在陆地上沿一定河道流动的水
books.plot: 人物沿河岸走，看水流经桥下，在安全位置观察河道延伸。
books.continuity: 河有两岸且持续延伸，水面有自然流动细节；不把静水杯或任意池塘称为 river。人物停留安全步道。

pages.text: My friend and I walk near a river.
pages.artwork: 两人在河岸步道，河道和两岸可见。

pages.text: The water moves in the river.
pages.artwork: 自然弯曲河道延伸，树木与岸线形成参照。

pages.text: The water goes under a bridge.
pages.artwork: 同一河段和桥，河水连续流经桥下。

pages.text: My friend and I watch the river from a safe place.
pages.chinese: 我们在安全的地方看河。
pages.artwork: 两人在有护栏或宽阔安全间隔的岸边观察。

check.prompt: Which is a river?
options: A long, natural body of moving water on land.
check.explanation: A river is a long, natural body of moving water on land.
check.chinese: 哪一种是河流？

output.sample: The river goes under the bridge.
output.taskChinese: 描述河与周围一个具体地点的关系。

books.title: From a small seed
books.teachingDefinition: a small part of a plant from which a new plant can come
books.senseChinese: 能在适当条件下长成新植物的种子
books.plot: 人物把一粒种子放入土中，照料后看见幼芽，说明种子是新植物的起点。
books.continuity: 同一花盆、一个明确种子、同一种植物。时间经过由网页说明，不画一浇水立即变大。
books.sourceDefinition: a small thing from a plant

pages.text: I have a small seed.
pages.artwork: 手掌中一粒真实可辨的种子，旁边是花盆。

pages.text: I put the seed in the earth in a pot.
pages.chinese: 我把种子放进花盆的土里。
pages.artwork: 手把同一粒种子放入浅土，容器一致。

pages.text: I give it water and time.
pages.artwork: 网页标明一些日子经过，人物温和浇水。

semanticText.label: Over some days
semanticText.accessibleSummary: I give the seed water over some days.

pages.text: A young plant comes from the seed.
pages.chinese: 一株幼小的植物从种子长出来。
pages.artwork: 同一花盆里出现幼芽，不出现完整成年大树。

semanticText.label: After some days
semanticText.accessibleSummary: After some days, a young plant comes from the seed.

check.prompt: What can a new plant come from?
check.explanation: A new plant can come from a seed when conditions are right.
check.chinese: 在合适条件下，新植物能从什么长出来？

output.frame: A ___ can come from a seed.
output.sample: A tree can come from a seed.
output.taskChinese: 指出一种由种子长成的植物；不声称每颗种子必定发芽。

books.title: To the other side
books.teachingDefinition: from one side to the other
books.senseChinese: 从一侧移动到另一侧
books.plot: 人物想去河对岸，通过桥从近岸走到远岸，完成跨越。
books.continuity: 起点和终点由固定桥及两岸区分；同一视角自然跟随，不用箭头、地图或路线叠加。
books.sourceDefinition: from one side to the other

pages.text: My friend is on the other side of the river.
pages.artwork: 两岸、连接两岸的桥与两位人物同框。

pages.text: I go to the bridge.
pages.artwork: 讲述者来到近岸桥头，朋友留在对岸。

pages.text: I walk across the bridge.
pages.artwork: 人物在桥中段向对岸走，桥两端清楚。

pages.text: Now I am on the other side with my friend.
pages.chinese: 现在我和朋友在另一边了。
pages.artwork: 讲述者到达朋友所在的一岸，完成跨越。

check.prompt: I walk across a room. Where do I go?
options: From one side to the other.
I am in the same place with no motion.
check.explanation: Across describes motion from one side to the other.
check.chinese: 我穿过房间，是怎样移动的？

output.sample: I go across the bridge.
output.taskChinese: 描述一条安全、明确连接两侧的路径。

books.title: A paper after payment
books.teachingDefinition: a paper that shows a payment
books.senseChinese: 证明已付款并记录交易的收据
books.plot: 人物在商店付款，收到交易收据，带回家查看自己支付了什么。
books.continuity: 插画里的小纸片无可读字；网页配套显示简短交易记录。必须通过付款过程说明收据，不能仅看纸形状猜。
books.sourceDefinition: a paper that shows a payment

pages.text: I buy a cup at the shop.
pages.artwork: 顾客和店员在柜台，杯子清楚。

pages.text: I pay for the cup.
pages.artwork: 顾客付款，杯子与同一店员保持连续。

pages.text: The shop gives me a receipt.
pages.artwork: 店员递小纸片；网页文字显示杯子及付款记录。

semanticText.label: Payment record
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This receipt shows a complete payment for one cup.

pages.text: The receipt shows my payment.
pages.artwork: 人物在家查看同一纸片，网页提供可读交易内容。

semanticText.label: Payment record
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This receipt shows a complete payment for one cup.

check.prompt: Which paper shows my payment for the cup?
check.explanation: The receipt records the payment for the cup.
check.chinese: 哪张纸能显示我已经付了杯子的钱？

output.sample: The receipt shows payment for a cup.
output.taskChinese: 根据一份明确示例收据说清楚付款对象。

books.title: Open the drawer
books.teachingDefinition: to move a thing to you
books.senseChinese: 把东西朝自己的方向拉
books.plot: 人物需要抽屉中的笔，握住把手向自己拉，抽屉打开后取出笔。
books.continuity: 侧面视角显示人物身体、手、把手和抽屉。抽屉朝人物移动，不把远离身体的推画成 pull。
books.sourceDefinition: to move a thing to you

pages.text: My pen is in the drawer.
pages.artwork: 人物站在关闭的桌抽屉前，网页说明笔在里面。

pages.text: I put my hand on the drawer.
pages.chinese: 我把手放到抽屉把手上。
pages.artwork: 侧面近景，抓握把手而非按桌面。

pages.text: I pull the drawer to me.
pages.artwork: 抽屉明显朝人物身体滑出，人物手臂配合回收。

pages.text: The drawer is open. I can take my pen.
pages.chinese: 抽屉打开了。我可以拿笔了。
pages.artwork: 抽屉打开，人物取出同一支笔。

check.prompt: To pull a box, which way do I move it?
check.explanation: Pull means moving a thing to the person doing the action.
check.chinese: 拉一个盒子，是把它朝哪个方向移动？

output.sample: I pull the drawer to me.
output.taskChinese: 用轻小物品安全示范拉的方向。

books.title: A stone and some water
books.teachingDefinition: not liquid or air
books.senseChinese: 固体，本篇用固定形状与液体对照
books.plot: 人物把水倒进不同容器，观察水随容器改变形状；同一块石头换容器后仍保持形状。
books.continuity: 稳定石头外形和大小；每页单一操作场景。只针对示例石头说明形状，不把所有可变形固体都排除。

pages.text: I have a stone and some water.
pages.chinese: 我有一块石头和一些水。
pages.artwork: 桌上同一石头、两只不同形状的容器和少量水。

pages.text: The water takes the form of its cup.
pages.chinese: 水呈现装它的杯子的形状。
pages.artwork: 人物把水倒入另一只容器，水面和容器形状可见。

pages.text: The stone keeps its form. It is solid.
pages.chinese: 石头保持形状。它是固体。
pages.artwork: 人物把同一石头换到另一容器旁，轮廓不变。

pages.text: This solid stone is different from the liquid water.
pages.chinese: 这块固体石头与液态水不同。
pages.artwork: 石头和水作为具体对比同时可见。

check.prompt: Which is solid in this story?
check.explanation: The stone is solid; the water is liquid.
check.chinese: 这个故事里哪一个是固体？

output.sample: The stone is solid.
output.taskChinese: 指出一种熟悉的固体，避免把“很硬”当固体定义。

books.title: Look at the plant
books.teachingDefinition: a fact learned by looking with care
books.senseChinese: 通过仔细看直接注意到的事实
books.plot: 人物观察植物叶片和土壤，先说可见现象，再把可能原因明确标为想法。
books.continuity: 叶片形态和盆土细节足够可见。观察、猜想写在网页，不在插画上加放大镜图标、流程框。
books.sourceDefinition: a thing you see by looking

pages.text: I look at the plant with care.
pages.artwork: 人物靠近同一盆植物查看叶片和土。

pages.text: One leaf is brown. That is my observation.
pages.chinese: 一片叶子是棕色的。这是我的观察。
pages.artwork: 一片棕叶在多片绿叶中清楚可辨，保持真实光照。

semanticText.label: What I see
semanticText.accessibleSummary: One brown leaf is a fact I can see.

pages.text: The earth is dry. That is another observation.
pages.chinese: 土是干的。这是另一个观察。
pages.artwork: 人物检查盆土，表面干燥特征可见。

semanticText.label: What I see
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The dry earth is another observation.

pages.text: It is possible that the plant needs water. I need more facts to be certain.
pages.chinese: 我有个想法：植物可能需要水。我需要更多事实才能确定。
pages.artwork: 人物准备进一步检查；不把缺水画成唯一已证实原因。

semanticText.label: One possible reason
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a possible reason, not a certain fact.

check.prompt: Which sentence is an observation?
options: It is possible that the plant is ill.
check.explanation: I can see the brown leaf. The other sentence gives a possible reason.
check.chinese: 哪一句是在说直接观察到的现象？

output.frame: I can see ___. My observation is ___.
output.sample: I can see a brown leaf. My observation is that one leaf is brown.
output.taskChinese: 先描述能看见的事实，再另外提出可能的解释。

books.title: A book in a parcel
books.teachingDefinition: a thing covered in paper for carrying or sending
books.senseChinese: 包好用于运送的一件或一组物品
books.plot: 人物把书放进盒子，包好成为包裹，交给负责运送的人。
books.continuity: 同一书与盒子；标签和地址全部由网页文字承担，插画上不出现可读文字。
books.sourceDefinition: a thing in paper for carrying

pages.text: I have a book for my friend.
pages.artwork: 人物在桌上准备一本书和空纸盒。

pages.text: I put the book in a box and cover it with paper.
pages.chinese: 我把书装进盒子，再用纸包好。
pages.artwork: 包装过程，只有一份书和盒子。

pages.text: Now it is a parcel.
pages.artwork: 包裹完整包好，形状与内部盒子对应。

pages.text: The parcel is ready to go to my friend.
pages.chinese: 包裹准备送到朋友那里。
pages.artwork: 人物把包裹交给服务台人员；地址在网页文字区。

semanticText.label: For my friend
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This parcel is for Anna at 2 Green Road.

check.prompt: A book is covered in paper for sending. What is it now?
check.explanation: A parcel is a thing covered in paper for carrying or sending.
check.chinese: 一本书已包好准备寄出，包好的这一件是什么？

output.sample: The parcel has a book in it.
output.taskChinese: 说明一个包裹里装有什么，以及要送给谁。

books.title: A letter from my friend
books.teachingDefinition: new knowledge about an event
books.senseChinese: 关于已发生事情的新消息
books.plot: 讲述者昨天打开朋友的信，知道朋友已完成工作，把新消息告诉家人。
books.continuity: 过去时间由网页 Yesterday 标记；信件内容用网页引用，插画书信无可读字。只教消息这一义，不把 news 当可数单件物品。

pages.text: Yesterday, I opened a letter from my friend.
pages.chinese: 昨天，我打开朋友的一封信。
pages.artwork: 人物在家拆信，网页明确昨天的情境。

semanticText.label: Yesterday
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a story about yesterday.

pages.text: My friend finished her work. This is the news in the letter.
pages.chinese: 朋友完成了工作。这是信中的消息。
pages.artwork: 人物读信；朋友完成工作的事实以网页信件短文呈现。

semanticText.label: Yesterday: from my friend
semanticText.accessibleSummary: The letter says that my friend finished her work.

pages.text: I talked with my family about the news.
pages.chinese: 我把这个消息告诉家人。
pages.artwork: 同一天稍后，人物与家人交谈，信仍在手中。

semanticText.label: Yesterday
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a story about yesterday.

pages.text: My family was happy about the good news.
pages.chinese: 家人听到这个好消息很高兴。
pages.artwork: 同一组家人自然交流，保持消息内容一致。

semanticText.label: Yesterday
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a story about yesterday.

check.prompt: My friend tells me that she finished her work. What is the news?
check.explanation: The news is the fact that the work is finished.
check.chinese: 朋友告诉我她完成了工作，新消息是什么？

output.sample: The news is that my friend finished her work.
output.taskChinese: 转述一条虚构或真实的简单消息，不要求分享私人信息。

books.title: A place for the plant
books.teachingDefinition: in the space separating 2 things
books.senseChinese: 在两个明确参照物之间
books.plot: 人物给盆栽找位置，先放在椅子旁，再移到椅子与窗户之间，朋友据此找到它。
books.continuity: 椅子、窗和盆栽在同一空间内，两个参照物始终完整可辨。不能只说画面中间就是 between。

pages.text: I need a place for the plant.
pages.chinese: 我需要给盆栽找个位置。
pages.artwork: 人物拿着小盆栽，椅子和窗都在场景中。

pages.text: First, I put it near the chair.
pages.chinese: 首先，我把它放在椅子旁。
pages.artwork: 盆栽位于椅子的远窗一侧，只满足 near。

pages.text: Then I put it between the chair and the window.
pages.chinese: 然后我把它放在椅子和窗之间。
pages.artwork: 盆栽位于两个指定参照物之间，位置关系清晰。

pages.text: My friend finds it between the 2 things.
pages.chinese: 朋友在这两样东西之间找到了它。
pages.artwork: 朋友按关系句找到同一盆栽。

check.prompt: A cup is between a book and a box. Which 2 things are on its sides?
check.explanation: Between needs the 2 named things in this scene.
check.chinese: 杯子在书和盒子之间，它两侧的参照物是哪两个？

output.sample: The cup is between the book and the box.
output.taskChinese: 完整说出目标物和两个参照物。

books.title: Take time with the cup
books.teachingDefinition: not quick
books.senseChinese: 动作或移动速度较慢，本篇不评价智力或能力
books.plot: 人物端一只满水杯走向桌子，为了不洒水放慢步伐，最后稳稳放下。
books.continuity: 静态插画只能支持小步、稳定端杯等动作线索；slow 的时间含义用网页句子与可选同路程时长记录补充，不能靠一张照片证明速度。

pages.text: The cup is full of water.
pages.artwork: 人物双手端杯，水面接近杯沿。

pages.text: I carry it with slow steps.
pages.artwork: 同一路径上谨慎小步，杯子保持水平。

pages.text: I am slow because I do not want to drop the cup.
pages.chinese: 我放慢速度，因为我不想把杯子掉在地上。
pages.artwork: 同一个连续搬运场景，网页解释速度和目的。

pages.text: I put the cup on the table with care.
pages.chinese: 我小心地把杯子放在桌上。
pages.artwork: 杯子安全落在桌面，水未洒出。

check.prompt: 2 persons walk the same way. One takes more time. In this comparison, is that person slow or quick?
check.explanation: For the same way, taking more time means moving more slowly.
check.chinese: 两个人走同一条路，一个人用时更长。在这次比较中，这个人是慢还是快？

output.sample: I am slow when I carry a full cup.
output.taskChinese: 说一个适合放慢动作的场景，不把慢等同于不好。

books.title: What will I do tomorrow?
books.teachingDefinition: on the condition that something happens
books.senseChinese: 某个条件成立时采用相应安排
books.plot: 人物在今天准备明天的两种安排：下雨在家，不下雨去花园；次日观察天气后执行其中一种。
books.continuity: 计划文字在网页，插画每页一个完整场景；两种计划不能画成两个已经同时发生的事实，不把 if 画成 because 的同义词。
books.sourceDefinition: on the condition that something happens

pages.text: I will do one of 2 things tomorrow.
pages.chinese: 明天，我会在两种安排中采用一种。
pages.artwork: 两人在室内看向窗外，准备讨论。

pages.text: If there is rain, I will be at home.
pages.artwork: 仍是计划中的室内场景，网页注明条件尚未确定。

semanticText.label: A possible future
lines: If there is rain, I will be at home.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is a possible action for tomorrow, not a fact about today.

pages.text: If there is no rain, I will go to the garden.
pages.chinese: 如果不下雨，我就去花园。
pages.artwork: 人物准备外出物品但仍在今天家中；网页说明另一条件。

semanticText.label: Another possible future
lines: If there is no rain, I will go to the garden.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: This is another possible action for tomorrow, not a fact about today.

pages.text: The next day, there is rain. I am at home.
pages.chinese: 到了第二天，下雨了。我在家里。
pages.artwork: 次日窗外下雨，两人在家读书，只执行一个分支。

semanticText.label: The next day
lines: There is rain. I am at home.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: There is rain now. I am at home.

check.prompt: If there is rain, I will be at home. There is rain now. Where will I be?
check.explanation: There is rain. The condition for being at home is true.
check.chinese: 计划说下雨就留家，现在下雨了，按计划该怎么做？

output.sample: If there is rain, I will be at home.
output.taskChinese: 给一项明确条件和相应计划；允许另一个合理的个人计划。

books.title: A button for my coat
books.teachingDefinition: a thin line used for joining cloth
books.senseChinese: 缝合布料时用的细线
books.plot: 成人发现纽扣松了，用针和线把纽扣缝牢，最后收好针具。
books.continuity: 成年人物操作，线的连续细长形态可见，针与线有清楚连接。不是给儿童的无监督操作说明。
books.sourceDefinition: a thin line used for joining cloth

pages.text: The button on my coat is loose.
pages.artwork: 成人在桌边查看纽扣与衣服连接处。

pages.text: I put thread through the needle.
pages.artwork: 近景显示细线穿过针孔，线轴和手比例自然。

pages.text: The thread joins the button to the cloth.
pages.chinese: 线把纽扣和布连在一起。
pages.artwork: 成人完成一针，线经过纽扣孔与衣料。

pages.text: Now the button is fixed. I put the needle in its box.
pages.chinese: 现在纽扣固定好了。我把针收好。
pages.artwork: 人物检查纽扣，针放回安全收纳盒。

check.prompt: Which thing joins cloth in this story?
check.explanation: The thin thread goes through the cloth and keeps the button in place.
check.chinese: 故事里是哪种材料把纽扣与布连起来？

output.sample: Thread is used to join cloth.
output.taskChinese: 说出线的用途；可以只描述画面，不实际操作针具。

books.title: A small bag can help
books.teachingDefinition: used to put different ideas together
books.senseChinese: 连接有对比或转折关系的两句话
books.plot: 人物以为小袋子装不了要带的书，实际发现它虽小却结实、装得下自己的物品。
books.continuity: 同一个小袋子与同一份书，尺寸和重量保持一致；不要用不合理超大容量制造转折。
books.sourceDefinition: used to show a different idea

pages.text: This bag is small.
pages.artwork: 桌上小布袋与一本可以装入的书同框。

pages.text: I have a book to carry.
pages.artwork: 人物拿书在袋口前比一比，仍是同一本书。

pages.text: The bag is small, but it is strong.
pages.artwork: 人物把书装入，袋子正常承重。

pages.text: It is small, but it can carry what I need.
pages.chinese: 它虽小，但装得下我需要的东西。
pages.artwork: 书装在袋中，人物自然提起，无夸张扩容。

check.prompt: The bag is old, but it is useful. Can I still use it?
options: No, old things have no use.
check.explanation: The sentence says the old bag is still useful.
check.chinese: 袋子虽然旧，但仍有用。我还能用它吗？

output.sample: My bag is old, but it is useful.
output.taskChinese: 说两件有真实转折关系的事，不是任意两句都接 but。

contextSupport.chinese: 这里说袋子结实，能承受重量

books.title: Rain changes my day
books.teachingDefinition: used to show what comes after a reason
books.senseChinese: 在原因之后引出相应结果
books.plot: 原计划去花园，出门时下雨，因此改为留家读书；把原因先说、结果后说。
books.continuity: 沿用已有读书人物，但雨、出门准备和留家行动明确连续。so 是本篇重点，because 作反向表达对照放网页。
books.sourceDefinition: used to show what comes after a reason
books.sourceExample: It is late, so I rest.

pages.text: I want to go to the garden.
pages.artwork: 两人在家门口准备出发。

pages.text: There is rain, so I am at home.
pages.artwork: 窗外下雨，两人把出门物品放回。

semanticText.label: The same reason and effect
lines: There is rain, so I am at home.
I am at home because there is rain.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: Rain is the reason. Being at home is the effect.

pages.text: I am at home, so I can read with my friend.
pages.chinese: 我在家里，所以可以和朋友一起读书。
pages.artwork: 两人在同一室内坐下打开书。

pages.text: I do not go to the garden. I read at home.
pages.chinese: 我不去花园了。我在家读书。
pages.artwork: 留家阅读的结果保持，不画另一条未执行的出行分支。

check.prompt: The cup is empty, so I put water in it. What is the effect?
options: I put water in the cup.
check.explanation: The empty cup is the reason. Putting water in it is the effect.
check.chinese: 杯子空了，所以我往里面倒水，结果是哪件事？

output.sample: There is rain, so I am at home.
output.taskChinese: 先说原因再说结果，再尝试改为 because 表达同一关系。

books.title: Tell me the reason
books.teachingDefinition: used to ask for a reason
books.senseChinese: 询问一件事的原因，而不是时间或地点
books.plot: 朋友看见讲述者带袋子、拿书、去学习，依次问原因；讲述者用 because 作答，最后自己提出一个问题。
books.continuity: 同一天同一对朋友，人物指代保持清楚。问题与回答由网页角色标识表达，插画不画问号或对话气泡。
books.sourceDefinition: used to ask for a reason

pages.text: My friend asks, "Why do you take a bag?"
pages.chinese: 朋友问：“你为什么带袋子？”
pages.artwork: 两人出门前，讲述者手持袋子，朋友自然询问。

pages.text: I take it because I want to carry my book.
pages.artwork: 讲述者把自己的书放进袋子，原因与行动一致。

pages.text: "Why do you study English?" my friend asks.
pages.chinese: 朋友问：“你为什么学英语？”
pages.artwork: 两人在学习室门口，场景衔接开篇学习目标。

pages.text: I study because I want to talk with more persons. What is your reason?
pages.chinese: 我学习，因为我想和更多人交流。你的原因是什么？
pages.artwork: 人物在学习室与不同的人交流，回扣一年的实用表达目标。

check.prompt: Why do I carry a cup? I want to drink water. Which answer gives the reason?
options: Because I want to drink water.
check.explanation: Why asks for a reason, not a place.
check.chinese: 问“为什么带杯子”，哪种回答提供了原因？

output.sample: Why do you study English? Because I want to talk with more persons.
output.taskChinese: 自己提出一个 why 问题，再用有意义的原因回答。

books.narratorChinese: 回答朋友提问的学习者
